tabs.name: Installed (N)
tabs.note: flat list of installed-only skills, live count in the label

actions.name: Installed on this agent
actions.note: badge shown instead of Install button when already installed

other.name: Installed-tab row
items: '· tap to view' hint (catalog skills only)

other.name: Custom-created skill row
other.note: row button renders disabled, no 'tap to view' hint - inconsistent with catalog-sourced rows, likely by-design (no file browser for inline-authored skills) but flagged as a UX inconsistency, not confirmed as a bug

modals.title: <skill name>
notes: Header: source badge (VelaOps/Anthropic/GitHub), version, author, license; GitHub-sourced skills additionally show a link to the exact pinned commit (e.g. 'github/awesome-copilot@fb80ec4').
Body: full rendered SKILL.md markdown (headings like 'When to use', 'How to use', code blocks, lists).
Sidebar panel 'FILES IN THIS SKILL': every file in the skill package with size, plus 'Installed at skills/<slug>/ in the agent's workspace. OpenClaw auto-discovers it on the next chat turn.'

modals.title: Create Skill
modals.description: Writes a SKILL.md file directly into this agent's workspace.
notes: All four fields marked required (*). Category defaults to 'custom' pre-filled.
